title: HI Tide Fly Fishing

services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: Fly Fishing Bonefish in Oahu Hawaii can be some of the most challenging yet rewarding fly fishing adventure. Our average Bonefish in Hawaii is 3-5 pounds and do see fish exceeding 10 pounds. These bigger fish are generally found in singles or doubles cruising and tailing on the flats. In Hawaii you won't see large schools of Bonefish on the flats like other fly fishing destinations, we do find smaller fish in smaller schools of 5-10 in the 2-5 pound range on the flats. Bonefish flats we fish here Hawaii can be sandy ankle deep water where we find tailing Bonefish to waist deep reef flats where we find cruising bonefish and Trevally.
